en-US.name: Across Us: Friends & Trips
en-US.subtitle: Share cities & travel plans
en-US.promotionalText: Trips now open on a globe: watch everyone’s flights land where you’re meeting, then tap anyone for their boarding pass.
en-US.description:
Your friends are spread across cities. Across Us helps you catch them when your paths cross: see where everyone is, find the dates you’ll be in the same city, and plan group trips with everyone’s flights in one place.

Made for friends who live apart — after graduation, a move abroad, or a new job across the country.

WHERE EVERYONE IS
• See the city each friend has shared, and when they last updated it.
• See when a friend is in the same city as you.
• Look back on the days you’ve shared a city, friend by friend.
• Keep friends on your Home Screen and Lock Screen with widgets.

WHEN YOU’LL MEET
• Add the cities and dates you’re traveling, and choose which friends can see them.
• Browse the travel plans friends share with you.
• When your shared plans put you in the same city, Together soon shows the days you overlap.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Create a shared trip and invite friends.
• Everyone adds their own flights, and the trip opens on a globe with every route flying in.
• Tap anyone for their boarding pass: local times, terminal, and their flight home.
• See who still needs to add a flight, and send them a reminder.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Friends see a city, never your exact location. Precise coordinates are not sent to our servers.
• No contacts upload, no ads, no cross-app tracking.
• Pause sharing for everyone or for one friend, and choose who sees each plan. Prefer not to share location? Pick your city manually.
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or a code sent to your email.

City updates, widgets and notifications depend on iOS permissions and connectivity. Confirm flight details with your airline.
en-US.whatsNew:
• Trips now open on a globe: watch everyone’s flights draw in and land where you’re meeting.
• Tap anyone on a trip to see their flight as a boarding pass, with local times, terminal and their flight home.
• Same-city moments now show your time together friend by friend, and a road trip through several cities counts as one trip with one alert.
• Sign in with Google or a code sent to your email, as well as with Apple.
• A Finish setting up card on You helps you turn on location and notifications.
• A simpler You tab, and more US cities have their own emblem.

zh-Hans.subtitle: 分享城市，发现下一次相聚
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 共同旅行现在从一颗地球开始：看大家的航班一起落地，点开任何人就是一张登机牌。
zh-Hans.keywords: 朋友,好友,同城,旅行,行程,航班,小组件,出行,聚会,见面,留学,异地,结伴
zh-Hans.description:
朋友散落在不同城市？Across Us 帮你抓住每一次相遇：看看大家在哪，发现你们会在同一座城市的日子；一起出发时，所有人的航班都在同一个行程里。

适合毕业后各奔东西、出国留学或异地工作的朋友。

大家现在在哪
• 查看每位好友分享的城市和更新时间。
• 朋友和你在同一座城市时，一眼就能看到。
• 按朋友回看你们在同一座城市度过的日子。
• 用小组件把朋友放在主屏幕和锁定屏幕上。

下一次在哪见
• 添加你要去的城市和日期，选择分享给哪些好友。
• 浏览朋友分享给你的出行计划。
• 双方分享的计划落在同一座城市时，“即将相聚”会显示你们重叠的日子。

一起旅行
• 创建共同旅行，邀请朋友加入。
• 每个人添加自己的航班，行程打开就是一颗地球，看所有人的航线飞向同一个目的地。
• 点开任何人就是一张登机牌：当地时间、航站楼和回程航班。
• 谁还没添加航班一目了然，还能提醒一下。

隐私，从设计开始
• 朋友只看到城市，看不到你的精确位置；精确坐标不会发送到我们的服务器。
• 不上传通讯录，没有广告，不做跨 App 追踪。
• 可以暂停对所有人或某位好友的城市共享，并为每份计划选择可见好友；不想授权定位，也能手动选择城市。
• 可以通过 Apple、Google 或邮箱验证码登录。

城市更新、小组件与通知受 iOS 权限和网络影响；航班信息请以航空公司为准。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
• 共同旅行现在从一颗地球开始：看大家的航线一条条画出，飞到你们见面的地方。
• 点开行程里的任何人，就能看到对方的登机牌：当地时间、航站楼和回程航班。
• 同城时刻按朋友展示你们在一起的日子；开车经过好几座城市算作一段旅程，也只提醒一次。
• 除了 Apple，现在也可以用 Google 或邮箱验证码登录。
• “你”页面新增“完成设置”卡片，帮你打开定位和通知。
• “你”页面更简洁，更多美国城市有了自己的城市徽章。
